summary_1line: Bharata prepares Ayodhya and journeys to meet Rama, joyfully reunites with him, returns the kingdom, and honors Rama before citizens and allies.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bharata, dressed in bark and antelope skin, carries Rama’s sandals on his head beneath a white parasol as the city procession marches toward Nandigrama.
The celestial chariot Pushpaka shines like the moon in the sky as citizens point upward and cry out that Rama has come.
Rama descends from the Pushpaka chariot and embraces Bharata, lifting his long-separated brother onto his lap before the gathered crowds.
